conviction_note: Mild negative lean (p_up 43) on a large scale (abs 8.5, the 6.5% event-implied move plus 92% realised vol): the independent series that exist (Gasgoo China installs, RoboSense's Q3, Li Auto's October) point to ADAS share loss and a full-year 3-3.5M unit target that needs Q4 >= 1.05M units, and the name sold its last two prints on margin; against that, consensus sits below the bottom of the company's revenue guide, the option skew pays for upside and DTC is 7.3, so p_up stays close to 50. Findings sum -2.2 and the scaled number is -1.19; the gap is that the findings are sized one by one while p_up carries the offsetting skew/short-interest caveat once.
bar: Company guide: Q3 2026 net revenue RMB1.10-1.15bn (~US$162-169m), Q3 lidar shipments 800-850k, FY2026 shipments 3.0-3.5M reiterated, FY gross margin ~40%, Q3 SGI revenue high-8-digit RMB (Q2 2026 release/call, 2026-08-18: https://www.webull.com/news/15463316535657472 ; https://stock.10jqka.com.cn/20260818/c679054178.shtml). Sell-side revenue consensus ~US$159.5m from ONE source (https://finviz.com/news/413902/hesai-must-prove-its-back-half-lidar-ramp-and-robotics-pivot-as-shares-sink, 2026-11-03), which sits BELOW the guide's bottom (was ~$176.5m before the guide); treated as disputed, so the company guide is the bar and findings resting on consensus are capped small. print_vs_bar_pct is revenue vs the guide midpoint/consensus blend: expected near the low end of guide (Q2 landed near the low end), i.e. ~+1.5% vs the $159.5m consensus, ~-1.5% vs guide midpoint.
positioning_check: Short interest 8,195,754 ADS at the 2026-10-15 FINRA settlement, ~5.2% of shares outstanding, 7.26 days to cover; model estimate for 2026-10-30 settlement 9.17M (+11.9%), official release due 2026-11-10 (https://equibles.com/stocks/hsai/shortinterest, read 2026-11-09). Moderate, not crowded by float %, but DTC 7.3 is real squeeze fuel. Baseline: 25d skew -3.64 vol pts (upside paid), put/call OI 0.72, event-implied move 6.52% (straddle 14.51% to 11-20 expiry), ATM spread 22% of mid. Tape: +16.26% over 5 sessions (from ~$12.30 on 2026-11-03 per finviz to $14.24-14.30) with no identified company catalyst; -5.42% over 20d; -50.3% from 52w high. Preview cites bullish sentiment 12.1%, down from 16.4% before the August print.

findings.finding: Gasgoo China passenger-car lidar installations: Hesai Jan-Aug 2026 1,055,637 (32.4%) vs Jan-Jul 928,870 (33.7%), so August alone = 126,767 units, a 25.3% share of the ~500.6k-unit month, while Huawei installed ~210.6k (42%) and RoboSense ~80.9k in August; Jul+Aug Hesai installs total ~286k (or ~355k on Gasgoo's internally inconsistent H1 table), against a Q3 shipment guide of 800-850k that, net of ~150-180k robotics units, needs ~630-690k ADAS units (Q1/Q2 ADAS deliveries ran ~1.04-1.13x China installs), i.e. September would need ~290-340k installs, far above any 2026 month.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-08-18): revenue near low end of guide and softer core lidar, ADS -5.3% on the day (baseline row, finviz). Q1 2026 (2026-05-19): ADS closed -9.0% on narrower margin (Dow Jones via itiger). Volume/mix shortfalls have been sold.
findings.why_not_priced: The Jan-Aug cumulative table was published 2026-10-31 and only gives cumulative shares (32.4% vs 33.7%); the monthly August figure (25.3% share) exists only by subtracting the 2026-09-21 Jan-Jul table, which no preview cited. If priced, previews would be flagging Q3 ADAS units below the 800-850k guide; the 2026-11-03 finviz preview instead calls the full-year target 'unchanged all year' and frames the risk as narrative. Caveat sized in: the company set the Q3 guide on 2026-08-18 knowing July; installs lag shipments and exclude exports; total units can be met via robotics.
findings.independence: Jan-Jul base from a separate Gasgoo release: https://autonews.gasgoo.com/articles/news/rankings-of-adas-component-suppliers-in-china-jan-jul-2026-dual-chamber-air-suspension-gains-traction-in-mainstream-vehicle-models-gasgoo-automotive-research-institute-2101869103731376129 (2026-09-21). Same direction from RoboSense's Q3 ADAS units (finding 4, different source) and GGII Jan-Sep: in 192-line+ high-performance main lidar RoboSense 43.99%, Huawei 40.09%, Seyond 15.90%, Hesai not in the top three (https://www.lanjinger.com/d/1789522200190628101, snippet_only). Proxy: installation data, not Hesai's own number.

findings.finding: The reiterated FY2026 target of 3.0-3.5M lidar units requires Q4 shipments of ~1.05-1.6M (H1 1,099,998 + Q3 guide 800-850k), i.e. +24% to +100% Q/Q over the Q3 guide top; with August China installs at a 2026 low share (finding 1) and Li Auto's October the lowest since February (finding 3), a trim of the full-year unit target or a Q4 revenue guide below the implied run-rate is a live risk on the line this stock trades on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025: two-thirds of volume in H2 and the Q3 2025 print (2025-11-11) raised the profit guide; US ADS ~+5% overnight then HK -11% next day 'results below expectations' (https://www.itiger.com/news/1188932101). 2026-08-18: Q3 guide below the then $176.5m consensus, ADS -5.3%, -22% since (finviz).
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is public and the preview notes the target is 'unchanged all year', so this is partly priced (stock -50% from 52w high, sentiment 12%). What would look different if fully priced: no +16% 5-day run-up into the print and a put-paid skew; instead the 25d skew is -3.64 (calls bid). A reiteration would be a positive surprise; a cut is not in the tape's lean.
findings.independence: Preview restating the 3-3.5M target and H1 1.1M: https://finviz.com/news/413902/hesai-must-prove-its-back-half-lidar-ramp-and-robotics-pivot-as-shares-sink (2026-11-03). Shares the company call with finding 8 (SGI) but a different line. Corroborated directionally by findings 1 and 3 (different sources).

findings.finding: Li Auto, Hesai's largest/exclusive ADAS customer, delivered 99,964 vehicles in Q3 2026 (+1.7% Q/Q, +7.2% Y/Y) and 29,025 in October (-8.6% Y/Y, -8.8% M/M, lowest since February), while Leapmotor (Q3 record 310,052, +25.9% Q/Q; October 106,127) and Xiaomi (October >50,000, a 2026 high, but now multi-sourcing with RoboSense) grew; Li Auto's new i6 (Hesai ATX platform) started deliveries 2026-10-29 with capacity targeted at 20,000/month in November.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history isolating customer deliveries; Q2 2026 core lidar softness (Li Auto down Y/Y three months running into June) coincided with the -5.3% August reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Customer delivery data is public and widely read, so mostly priced; the Hesai-specific transmission (flat Li Auto into Q3, weak October into Q4) matters only through the Q4 guide. Net of the rest: Leapmotor and Xiaomi growth and the i6 ramp offset most of it, hence the small size.
findings.independence: Li Auto Q3 totals: https://cnevpost.com/2026/10/01/li-auto-sept-2026-deliveries/ (2026-10-01); Leapmotor Q3: https://cnevpost.com/2026/10/01/leapmotor-sept-2026-deliveries/ ; Xiaomi multi-sourcing with RoboSense noted in the finviz preview. Proxy: customer volumes, not Hesai's.

findings.finding: RoboSense pre-announced Q3 2026 lidar sales of 595,600 units (+220.9% Y/Y), ADAS 450,400 (vs ~436,600 for all of H1, so roughly double Q2) and robotics 145,200 (vs 282,600 in H1, i.e. about flat Q/Q); Hesai, which has not pre-released, is losing ADAS share at the margin to RoboSense (Xiaomi), and the robotics market Hesai counts on (>500k FY target, needs H2 >= 240k) is not visibly accelerating sequentially at the peer.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Peer read-through has not been isolated in Hesai's history; Hesai's robotics line (Q2 +193% Y/Y) was the bright spot of the August print and the stock still fell 5.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: A peer released after Hesai last spoke (2026-08-18). RoboSense's headline was read as 'lidar demand strong', which is sector-positive; the share-shift reading (RoboSense ADAS nearly doubling Q/Q while Hesai's August installs fell) is not in any Hesai preview found. If priced, the preview would discuss RoboSense's Q3 ADAS jump explicitly; it mentions only the Xiaomi supplier addition.
findings.independence: RoboSense H1 basis: https://kyodonewsprwire.jp/release/202608274841 (2026-08-27, not fetched, search snippet). Same direction as finding 1 (Gasgoo, different publisher dataset). Could cut the other way: strong peer ADAS volume implies a strong total market.

findings.finding: The only sourced sell-side revenue consensus (~US$159.5m) sits below the bottom of Hesai's own Q3 guide (US$162-169m / RMB1.10-1.15bn), down from ~$176.5m before the guide, so a print even at the low end of guide reads as a headline revenue beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Hesai has landed near the low end of guide (Q2 2026) and was sold anyway; Q3 2025 beat and was sold in HK the next day. Headline beats have not been paid.
findings.why_not_priced: Aggregated USD consensus appears stale or FX-mismatched against the RMB guide; headline-scraping algos will print 'beat'. Capped small because the bar has one source and the stock's reaction function ignores headline beats.
findings.independence: Guide from the company call: https://www.webull.com/news/15463316535657472 (2026-08-18). Consensus has no second source.

findings.finding: The ADS rose ~16% in five sessions into the print (from ~$12.30 on 2026-11-03 to $14.24 close 2026-11-09) with no company catalyst found, raising the bar into a release on a name that fell on 3 of its last 4 prints; against that, short interest is 8.2M ADS, ~5.2% of shares outstanding with 7.26 days to cover (2026-10-15) and estimated rising to ~9.2M at 2026-10-30.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 -9.0%, Q2 2026 -5.3%; Q4 2025 (2026-03) reported +6.4% despite an EPS miss (low-quality source); no squeeze history found.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is the price itself; filed so the panel sees the two offsetting mechanisms (run-up raising the bar vs. 7-day DTC short squeeze fuel), sized near zero net.
findings.independence: Price on 2026-11-03 from the finviz preview (https://finviz.com/news/413902/hesai-must-prove-its-back-half-lidar-ramp-and-robotics-pivot-as-shares-sink); run-up from the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: Gross margin has stepped down from 42.2% (H1 2025) to 39.7% (H1 2026; Q1 39.1%, Q2 40.1%) with Q2 lidar ASP ~RMB1,297 and product revenue +27% on volume +101%; peer RoboSense's H1 gross margin fell 25.9% -> 21.8% citing lower ASPs AND higher raw-material costs, which, with the 2026 memory/commodity cost rise, puts Hesai's 'close to 40%' FY margin guide at risk in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin is the line this name trades on: Q1 2026 -9.0% on narrower margin, Q2 2026 -5.3% 'as margins weakened' (finviz, itiger).
findings.why_not_priced: The input-cost leg comes from the peer's interim (2026-08-27, after Hesai spoke) and is not in Hesai's previews, which say margin 'held near 40% despite pricing pressure'. Partly priced: the ASP decline is well known. Proxy for the cost leg.
findings.independence: RoboSense H1 margin and cause: https://news.10jqka.com.cn/20260928/c680301323.shtml (2026-09-28, snippet_only). ASP RMB1,297 from H1 analysis via the 10jqka article above (H1 figures https://stock.10jqka.com.cn/20260823/c679195676.shtml). Shares the 10jqka H1 document with no other finding.

findings.finding: SGI (actuation/Kosmo) was guided to high-8-digit RMB revenue in Q3 (vs RMB45m in Q2) toward a raised FY guide of RMB200-300m; Kosmo, Kosmo One and Kosmo World launched 2026-10-14 with Galbot, Dynamics Lab, Pixar RenderMan and Amap partners, giving the call a physical-AI narrative the market has bid before (HK +5% on 2026-10-26).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The SGI guide raise on 2026-08-18 did not prevent a -5.3% day; narrative product launches moved HK +5-10% intraday (2026-10-26).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced as narrative; SGI is ~5-8% of revenue and operating-loss making (Q2 loss RMB64m), and much of actuation runs through Sharpa, the CEO's co-founded related party (supply cap tripled to RMB300m). Net of the 92% of revenue that is lidar, small.
findings.independence: Q3 SGI guide from the call: https://www.webull.com/news/15463316535657472 (shares that document with finding 2).

baseline_tension: The negative lean cuts against the -3.64 skew (upside paid) and the +16% 5-day run-up, and agrees with the name's habit of selling prints (3 of last 4 down) and the -50% drawdown; p_up is held at 43 rather than lower because the option market and a 7-day DTC short base lean the other way and the evidence is proxy data, not a Hesai number.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar): consensus has one source and sits below the company guide, so the consensus-beat finding (5) capped +0.8 -> +0.5 and the company guide named as the bar.
Rule 7 (skew/short): negatives run against an upside-paid skew and 7.3 days to cover; positioning finding -0.3 -> -0.2, guidance finding -1.2 -> -1.0, p_up 42 -> 43.
Rule 5 (proxy): installs (1) -0.8 -> -0.7, RoboSense read-across (4) -0.4 -> -0.3, peer-cost margin (7) -0.6 -> -0.5; all kept filed as small proxies.
Rule 9 (segment) and rule 1 (reaction): Li Auto customer finding (3) left at -0.2 net of Leapmotor/Xiaomi; margin line kept negative because this name sold its last two prints on margin.
Lesson on untrustworthy FPI history: base rate rebuilt from confirmed prints (-9.0%, -5.3%, ~+5%, +6.4%) and the 92% realised vol; abs_move_pct left at 8.5.
